source: probed 2026-11-24 against pi 1.6.0 (npm @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent; rig: a fake OpenAI-compatible model, a PTY, Novadeck's headless emulator; backups/pi-harness-2026-11-24/rig)
how: Each state read with `readScreen`: `rows` the rows that show anything, `bright` those whose dim cells blank some of their text, `lit` cells whose background stands out, `cursor` the cursor. Sizes: names ending 60 are 60x20, names ending in a size are that size, the rest 120x40. No colour query answered (the runner's headless emulator answers only DA), so pi draws its 16-colour theme. `ctrl*` states: Ctrl+C twice within ~1 s quits pi (`emptyOnce` is the screen after it exited).
